current_validation.scope: Deployed PR #58 baseline. Subsequent branch tests are additional offline evidence, not live-payment or independent acceptance.

evidence_boundary: Test references are evidence of specific fictional/offline behaviours, not completion of the full outcome or proof of live wallet/charger compatibility.
